info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Connect Components Configurations-v5-spec
info.description: The Connect Components Configuration Retrieval API enables users to access and view detailed configurations for various connect components within the microservices architecture. This API is essential for developers and system administrators who need to manage and troubleshoot component settings. It provides insights into configuration parameters that can be used for system optimization and integration. Typical consumers include software engineers and DevOps teams looking to ensure consistent application behavior across deployments.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of all available configuration settings in the system. It is useful for understanding current configurations and making decisions based on them.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving configurations. It should include appropriate filters or parameters to specify the configurations you are interested in.

ListConnectComponentsConfigurationsReque.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the S Configurations API. It is expected to be a JSON string.

ListConnectComponentsConfigurationsRespo.title: Get Configurations Response
ListConnectComponentsConfigurationsRespo.description: Schema representing the response for the GET configurations operation. It includes a list of items and metadata related to the response.

ConfigurationItem.title: Configuration Item

id.description: The unique identifier for the configuration item.

filterAccounts.description: A list of accounts that are filtered based on this configuration item.

items.description: The identifier of an account that is filtered.

accountClassificationType.description: A list of account classification types associated with this configuration.

aoRequired.description: Indicates whether action order is required for this configuration item.

ConfigurationItem.description: A schema that represents an individual configuration item.

correlationId.description: Identifier for tracing requests across services.
